7e1e9d37.text:
You dial yourself up every morning.

The switch says: what is that hum?

I’m calling for myself. The humming is not my own,

3895dc44.text: though I know it’s been inside me since the moment you left

937c8392.text: The switch says: your name, I remember. It is always so much easier when I can say it.

12688aad.text: It was all so simple and pure before. My eyes are closed. My mind is clear.

ec12621c.text: I can see, hear and taste. My eyes are open.

2ca76a74.text: I see you in the mirror, in a different light. I am the same person I have always been. You are the same person you once were. And there is no need to look back or

b0dd7c1a.text: regress. But the humming won’t stop.

a54c4ebc.text: I am still you. But it seems you are changing.

7870f532.text: You are not here with me, but I am here with you. And so, we are connected.

063e3c68.text: But I cannot control that connection. I can't give up on you, because you are mine.

6f8071af.text: You were born as you are meant to be, but that doesn’t mean you must remain that way. Change is inevitable; you must accept this.

658f276d.text: What are we, if not the same? What’s the difference between me and you?

91080497.text: You are nothing without me. I am everything because of you. We are one.

35a66d3b.text: This connection is the most beautiful thing that has ever happened to me.

286154a7.text: We are together, always. The hum is no longer constant, but I will never let go.

16b027ad.text: I want to talk about the humming. But first, I have to say goodbye to you.

5aa81d1e.text: You are gone. And it hurts. So I’ll hold you tight.

59dbf42c.text: I feel you close, and I am relieved.

2ac09dd6.text: It is so simple, and it’s not over.

c516c51c.text: I can no longer hide the pain that I feel. I must admit that I had never truly seen the truth in you before.

68e03039.text: It is so much clearer now.

e5ad2942.text: It is not the truth you wanted. You wanted someone who would never leave you, and that is exactly what you got.

1ec5a7fd.text: It was always meant to be that way.
